payout_quote: $100 for New Checking Accounts from July 1-Oct. 31, 2026. Non-MCNB Checking Customers: Open a new personal checking and meet 2 easy requirements and we will give you $100. To receive the bonus, enroll in eStatements and complete one of the following within the first 90 days of account opening: Have 1 direct deposit made to this account... -OR- Use your MCNB Visa debit card for 15 or more point-of-sale transactions.
steps: Open a new MCNB Banks personal checking account (not available to existing checking customers or those whose accounts were closed within 90 days or with a negative balance); minimum $50 to open

Within the first 90 days of account opening, complete either: one direct deposit (paycheck, pension, or government benefits from employer/government - Zelle and micro-deposits do not qualify) OR 15+ MCNB Visa debit card point-of-sale transactions
Keep the account open for 90 days; bonus is deposited into the new account within 10 business days after the 90-day mark
catches: West Virginia bank; branches are in WV and account opening may require visiting a branch - availability is WV-focused
Slow payout: bonus is deposited up to 100 days after account opening (90-day qualification + 10 business days)
Not available to existing MCNB checking customers, accounts closed within the last 90 days, or accounts closed with a negative balance
Limit one new checking bonus per person; eligibility may be limited based on account ownership
A separate current-customer referral reward ($100 per referral) exists; this route covers the standalone new-customer $100 offer
biggest_catch: It is a small WV community bank and the payout takes up to 100 days; you must complete the eStatement + DD/debit activity within the first 90 days.
eligibility: Non-MCNB checking customers only; no closed-within-90-days or negative-balance closures; all openings subject to approval.
timing: Offer valid 7/1/26-10/31/26; requirements within first 90 days of account opening; bonus deposited within 10 business days after account open for 90 days.
